    FMOD Plus

    FMOD Plus provides runtime components and Editor tools that make FMOD for Unity feel closer to Unity's built-in AudioSource workflow.

    Use FMODAudioSource, Global and Local Key Lists, Command Sender, and Event Trigger to configure common audio behavior without coupling gameplay code to individual FMOD event paths. The Setup window also detects FMOD for Unity and can migrate an Assets-based integration to an Embedded UPM package.

    Main features

    • AudioSource-style event playback through FMODAudioSource.
    • Searchable AMB, BGM, and SFX Global Key Lists.
    • Per-GameObject Local Key Lists.
    • Event or Key-based commands and Unity lifecycle triggers.
    • Initial FMOD parameter overrides.
    • FMOD installation detection and guarded Embedded UPM migration.
    • Support for Fast Enter Play Mode.

    Start with Requirements, Installation, and Getting started.

    Note

    This documentation starts with FMOD Plus 1.7.0. Earlier releases remain available in the Changelog, but do not have separate manual versions.
